rows.label: Engine type
rows.value: Liquid-cooled four-stroke inline-four; 16 valves; double overhead camshafts

rows.label: Fuel system
rows.value: Programmed Fuel Injection (PGM-FI); 36 mm throttle bore

rows.label: Unrestricted rated power
rows.value: 92 kW (123.4 mechanical hp / 125 metric PS) at 10,000 rpm

rows.label: Lubrication
rows.value: Wet sump; forced pressure; trochoid pump

rows.label: Chain slack
rows.value: 25–35 mm; ignition off, sidestand, transmission in neutral

rows.label: Length × width × height
rows.value: 2,105 × 785 × 1,095 mm; U (Australia/New Zealand) type length 2,115 mm

rows.label: Front pressure, cold
rows.value: 250 kPa (36 psi), rider only or with passenger

rows.label: Rear pressure, cold
rows.value: 290 kPa (42 psi), rider only or with passenger

rows.label: Tread service limits
rows.value: Front 1.5 mm; rear 2.0 mm (manual limits, not local legal limits)

rows.label: Brakes
rows.value: Front: hydraulic twin discs; rear: hydraulic single disc. CB1000RA adds Combined ABS.

rows.label: Spark plug gap
rows.value: 0.80–0.90 mm; do not adjust the iridium plug gap

rows.label: Fork fluid level
rows.value: CB1000R: 91 mm; CB1000RA: 67 mm. Follow the fork filling procedure.

rows.label: Fork initial settings
rows.value: Preload: 8 turns from minimum; rebound and compression: 2 turns out from full hard

rows.label: Rear shock initial settings
rows.value: Preload position 3; rebound 1½ turns out from full hard

rows.label: Ignition / starting
rows.value: Computer-controlled digital transistor ignition; electric starter

rows.label: CB1000RA additional ABS fuses
rows.value: Main 10 A; fail-safe relay 30 A; motor 30 A

rows.label: Engine oil filter cartridge
rows.value: 26 N·m; oil the threads and O-ring

fluids.label: Engine Oil
fluids.capacity: 2.7 L after draining; 3.0 L with filter; 3.6 L after disassembly
fluids.spec: SAE 10W-30; API SG or higher, excluding energy-conserving oils; JASO T 903 MA.

fluids.label: Coolant
fluids.capacity: 3.0 L radiator and engine; 0.35 L reserve tank
fluids.spec: Silicate-free ethylene glycol antifreeze; 1:1 with distilled water.

fluids.label: Brake Fluid
fluids.spec: DOT 4, front and rear. Use the procedure matching the ABS equipment.

fluids.label: Fork Oil
fluids.capacity: Per leg: CB1000R 511 ± 2.5 mL; CB1000RA 542 ± 2.5 mL
fluids.spec: Honda ULTRA CUSHION OIL 10W or equivalent; follow the model-specific fluid-level procedure.
